name: Bone Pitch Right
purpose: Get outside in a hurry. The fullback dives to hold the middle, the quarterback attacks the edge and pitches. Against a defense that has crowded the box to stop the dive, this is where the yards are.

LE.rule: Cut off pursuit from behind. You are the last one to the ball, so never quit on the play.

LT.rule: Block back. Take the first defender on or inside you — nobody crosses your face.

LG.rule: Nobody is over you. Cut off the backside — nothing chases this from behind.

C.rule: Reach the nose. Get your head across his playside shoulder.

RG.rule: Nobody is over you. Climb to the middle linebacker and cut him off from the sideline.

RT.rule: The tackle is on your inside shoulder. Get your head across him and wall him off so he cannot chase.

RE.rule: Release outside and block the deepest defender on your side.

QB.rule: Fake the dive to the fullback, attack the outside, and pitch the ball to the halfback before you get touched. Pitch early, not late.

FB.rule: Run the dive path and get tackled. Your fake is what keeps their linebackers inside.

LH.rule: Run behind the quarterback and get to the corner ahead of the ball. Kick out the first defender who shows.

RH.rule: Stay outside and behind the quarterback, catch the pitch on the run, and get to the corner. Never stop your feet.

coaching_points: The pitch goes early. A quarterback who waits to be tackled first will pitch it on the ground.
This is not a read at this age — tell him before the snap that he is pitching it.
The halfback must stay behind the quarterback until he has the ball. Getting ahead means the pitch goes forward, which is a fumble waiting to happen.
